description: This file defines classes related to memory management in PyTorch's JIT runtime, including StorageGroup, ManagedStorages, and MemoryPlanner, with functions for managing tensor storage and memory optimization in static runtime.

classes.name: StorageGroup
classes.description: Represents a collection of tensors sharing backing storage, with methods to add tensors and manage maximum tensor size.

classes.name: ManagedStorages
classes.description: Manages a contiguous buffer of StorageImpl objects, with methods for allocation, deallocation, and access.

classes.name: MemoryPlanner
classes.description: Base class for managing memory planning, including allocation and deallocation of tensors and output tensors.

classes.name: StandardMemoryPlanner
classes.description: Derived class implementing specific memory management strategies with managed tensor groups.

methods.name: assignStorageToManagedTensors
methods.description: Assigns storage to managed tensors based on graph nodes and tensor ranges.

methods.name: MemoryPlanner
methods.description: Constructor initializing the memory planner with runtime context and options.

methods.name: deallocateOutputTensors
methods.description: Deallocates output tensors managed by the memory planner.
